hotel.name: The St. Regis Hotel Washington D.C.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is located two blocks from the White House.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel is desirably located just two blocks from The White House and conveniently close to numerous embassies and other diplomatic offices.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has hosted presidents including FDR and Truman.
verified_facts.excerpt: has hosted royalty, business magnates, and presidents, including FDR and Truman

verified_facts.text: The building has Beaux-Arts architecture.
verified_facts.excerpt: the hotel blends timeless Beaux-Arts architecture

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a member of Historic Hotels of America.
verified_facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Washington, D.C. proudly partners with Historic Hotels of America

verified_facts.text: The grand lobby has ornate Florentine gold ceilings and crystal chandeliers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests arrive at a grand lobby adorned with ornate Florentine gold ceilings, crystal chandeliers

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite was decorated by the interior design firm Myron Wolman Designs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Decorated by the celebrated interior design firm, Myron Wolman Designs, the Presidential Suite represents a truly unique expression of luxury.

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite connects with a Superior Room so it can be configured as a two-bedroom suite.
verified_facts.excerpt: The suite connects with a Superior Room allowing the rooms to be configured as a two-bedroom suite.

verified_facts.text: All suites come with St. Regis Butler Service.
verified_facts.excerpt: All suites come with signature St. Regis Butler Service to elevate your stay in D.C.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms have Pratesi linens and Remède Spa bath products.
verified_facts.excerpt: each room has Pratesi linens and wonderful bathrooms with Remède Spa products

verified_facts.text: The signature restaurant, Alhambra, is named after the Alhambra palace and fortress in southern Spain.
verified_facts.excerpt: Exceptional dining awaits at the hotel’s signature restaurant, Alhambra. Named after the landmark Alhambra palace and fortress in southern Spain

verified_facts.text: Alhambra serves shareable plates drawing on flavors of the Iberian Peninsula and the Middle East.
verified_facts.excerpt: shareable plates that draw on the flavors...See More of the Iberian Peninsula and the Middle East

verified_facts.text: Alhambra is open for breakfast, brunch, lunch and dinner.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open for breakfast, brunch, lunch and dinner

verified_facts.text: The hotel holds a nightly Champagne Sabering ritual in the grand lobby.
verified_facts.excerpt: join us for our nightly Champagne Sabering ritual at 6:00 PM daily in our grand lobby

verified_facts.text: Afternoon Tea is served in the hotel's lobby lounge and changes with the season.
verified_facts.excerpt: Delight in our renowned Afternoon Tea experience in the hotel’s opulent lobby lounge. Presenting an extraordinary presentation that changes with the season

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Bar serves seasonal cocktails, a global wine list and small bites.
verified_facts.excerpt: enjoy seasonal cocktails, a global wine list and extraordinary small bites in the iconic St. Regis Bar

verified_facts.text: The Capital Mary is the hotel's take on the Bloody Mary, inspired by the Chesapeake Bay region.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience our unique take on the traditional Bloody Mary, inspired by the cultural heritage of the nearby Chesapeake Bay region.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours for hotel guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: On-site Fitness Center. Open 24 hours for hotel guests.

verified_facts.text: Bicycle rental is complimentary.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Bicycle Rental

Complimentary

verified_facts.text: Pets up to 25 pounds are welcome for a non-refundable fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, pets are welcome at The St. Regis Washington, D.C.. with a maximum weight of 25.0 lbs.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport is about 5 miles from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: DCA is located approximately 5.0 Miles from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 21

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers dedicated office space that can serve as temporary law firm offices for trial preparation or depositions.
verified_facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Washington, D.C. offers dedicated office space, which can serve as temporary law firm offices for trial preparation, deposition space or a convenient "war room".

verified_facts.text: A personal butler is available around the clock.
